description: Installation of 34 shipping container office units with associated access, cycle parking, refuse storage, landscaping and ancillary works.
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development, by way of the proposed massing, bulk, layout, height, scale and materials to provide 34 offices, would be unacceptable within the existing urban form in the vicinity and the wider locality which is a residential setting, contrary to policies D1 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), policy 28 and 53 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposed development by way of potential overlooking to cause privacy concerns, shadowing, loss of sunlight, may cause considerable harm the amenity of neighbouring occupiers and insufficient information has been submitted to determine otherwise, as such the application is contrary to Policy 57 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024).</p>

<p style="list-style-type:none"><span style="line-height:normal">&nbsp;The proposed scheme does not account for the several mature trees adjoining the site and thus harm could be caused to their well-being, without further information to support that their well-being would not be impacted, the development does not comply with </span>Policy 79 or 80 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).&nbsp;</p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The application is not supported with </span>sufficient transport and construction information to enable a robust assessment of the proposal. <span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Insufficient information has been provided with regards to trip generation, a transport plan, and to make an assessment of parking demand for staff and visitors and deliveries associated with the development. Whilst no on-site parking is proposed, the applicant has not demonstrated that staff and visitor travel demand, or deliveries and servicing can be accommodated without resulting in displacement parking on the surrounding highway network and private access road or </span>an adverse impact on the safe and efficient operation of the local highway network. Overall the application is not supported by Policy 60, 63, 66 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024) or T4 and T7 of the London Plan (2021).&nbsp;</p>
